title: A covert operation disguised as progress
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji believed everything was under control, Cang Yutian's figure had silently appeared in the night outside the city of Tianqing Sect. On the chessboard of destiny, an unexpected piece had fallen onto his most vulnerable position.

text.content: Two secret spiritual energy fluctuations almost simultaneously drilled into the Mental Sea - Su Qingyao's message was brief and urgent: 'Ling Yuan is having secret talks with the imperial envoys, be careful.' Ye Qing's intelligence was more detailed: 'The Axis of Destiny involves deep matters, the imperial court has other schemes this time.' Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his face still wore that harmless smile, as if he were merely admiring the scenery of the heavens. What was even more unsettling was that in the corner of the crowd, an elderly gaze pierced through the void, tightly locked onto him - it was Ling Yuan, his murky old eyes now sharp as a blade.

The Heavenly Banquet, lights shining brilliantly. Celestial cranes circled above the crystal towers, the nectar in the crystal goblets flowing with seven-colored spiritual light. Senior officials from the three major sects stood on both sides, the imperial envoy Zhao Wuji sat in the center, his brocade robe embroidered with a five-clawed golden dragon, proudly surveying all living beings. Chen Ji sat at the lowest seat, the spiritual fruits before him being devoured until juice splashed everywhere, looking exactly like a country bumpkin who had never seen the world. The surrounding disciples whispered to each other, their eyes full of contempt - a waste is a waste, even his eating manner is so shameful.

dialogue.content: 'So this is Chen Ji of Tianqing Sect? I've heard your name for quite some time.' Zhao Wuji's gaze suddenly fell on him, a playful smile at the corner of his mouth, 'I heard you had some fortuitous encounter in the Forbidden Grounds recently? How about it, have you found the Tianji Record fragment?'

text.content: Chen Ji put down the spiritual fruit in his hand, scratching his head with an innocent expression: 'What treasure does Your Excellency speak of? I'm just a nobody with no influence, I've never even heard the name Tianji Record.' He blinked his eyes, looking completely innocent. A flash of disappointment crossed Zhao Wuji's eyes - truly a waste, doesn't even know the Tianji Record. He had no idea that Chen Ji had already carved the three characters 'Tianji Record' into the deepest part of his memory. Waste persona, activated.

Seeing Chen Ji in this cowardly state, Zhao Wuji became even more interested, lowering his voice to 'enlighten' him: 'You're quite an interesting lad. Since you've entered the game of the Heavenly Realm, this official will kindly tell you - the imperial court has already discovered that the secret of the Axis of Destiny lies within the Tianji Record. As long as you find the holder, you can follow the clues.' Chen Ji nodded repeatedly while listening, but in his heart he coldly laughed: So that's it, the imperial court's hands have already reached into the three major sects.

choice.prompt: Zhao Wuji got carried away talking and continued revealing that the imperial court had planted informants in all three major sects. You decide:

choices.text: Play dumb to extract more information
choices.description: Present yourself as atrashto lower the enemy's guard, let him continue talking
choices.visible_cost: Might be seen as an easy target

text.content: Chen Ji tilted his head, blinking his eyes in bewilderment, looking just like a fool who can't understand human speech.

dialogue.content: 'What Your Excellency says is too profound, the little one only understood that the Tianji Record is very important... Then among the three major sects, who has the best chance of obtaining it?'

choices.text: Use questions to make him reveal more
choices.description: Seemingly harmless questions, yet they guide the other party to reveal more key details

text.content: Chen Ji pretended to be curious, pricking up his ears to listen.

dialogue.content: 'Your Excellency said that finding the holder would lead to the Axis of Destiny... But what if they can't find it? What would the imperial court do?'

text.content: Zhao Wuji sneered: 'Can't find it? Then create opportunities for them to find it.' He glanced meaningfully at the positions of the three major sects, 'Three ants fighting each other, surely one will bite out the answer.' Chen Ji's heart tightened - the imperial court intends to make the three major sects destroy each other! His peripheral vision caught Ling Yuan's direction, discovering that old fox was thoughtfully looking at Zhao Wuji, some kind of tacit understanding seeming to exist between them.

In the corner, Ling Yuan's gaze was as cold and sinister as a venomous snake. Chen Ji noticed that this old patriarch of Tianqing Sect was exchanging meaningful glances with Zhao Wuji, far from ordinary sect diplomacy. He coldly laughed in his heart: Old thing, you've hidden deep enough. The Heaven's Eye in his sleeve slightly vibrated, having completely recorded this scene. At the same time, Chen Ji secretly issued an order to the Heaven's Eye: use their own methods against them - it was time to plant the seeds of suspicion among the three major sects.

The Heaven's Eye transformed into an intangible force, quietly shuttling through the crowd. It transmitted Zhao Wuji's arrogant words 'three ants' to the Xuanwu Sect disciples, and revealed Ling Yuan's private relationship with Zhao Wuji to the White Tiger Sect representatives. Soon, the atmosphere in the venue became subtle. Han Lie, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect,scoffed coldly一声, the elders of White Tiger Sect whispered among themselves, even Ling Yuan's expression became somewhat uncomfortable - he clearly sensed something was not quite right.

choice.prompt: The fake intelligence is taking initial effect, the three major sects are mutually suspicious. You decide:

choices.text: Add more fuel to the fire
choices.description: Seize the opportunity to reveal some more 'inside information', making their contradictions even more intense
choices.visible_reward: The three parties completely break apart
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might be watching you

text.content: Chen Ji took advantage of the chaos, quietly approaching Xuanwu Sect's seat, 'accidentally' letting slip words.

dialogue.content: (Whispering) I heard the imperial court only values Tianqing Sect, the other two families are merely discarded pieces...

choices.description: Today's harvest is already enough, shouldn't be too flamboyant

text.content: Chen Ji quietly retreated to the corner, continuing to play his role as atrash.

dialogue.content: (Inner: The fish today is enough, time to pull in the net.)

After the banquet, Su Qingyao quietly followed Chen Ji: 'Senior brother, I've noticed something.' She lowered her voice, a hint of worry flickering in her eyes, 'Elder Ancestor Ling Yuan... seems to be very close with the imperial envoy.'

text.content: Chen Ji 'surprisingly' widened his eyes: 'Junior sister, you're overthinking it. With the Elder Ancestor's noble character, how could he...' Su Qingyao shook her head: 'I saw them talking privately with my own eyes, and the Elder Ancestor even handed over a letter.' She paused, 'The envelope bore the imperial court's secret mark.' Chen Ji's heart tightened - Su Qingyao's investigation was deeper than he had imagined, and the chess game he had set up was playing its role perfectly.

Meanwhile, Ye Qing's intelligence network had also sent back news. She had intercepted part of the communication between Zhao Wuji and Ling Yuan through demonic path secret techniques - the imperial court promised that as long as Ling Yuan cooperated in finding the Tianji Record, they would guarantee him the position of Sect Master of Tianqing Sect. In exchange, Ling Yuan needed to cultivate forces for the imperial court within the sect, while monitoring the movements of the other two sects. After reading the intelligence, Chen Ji's lips curled into a cold smile: As expected, the old fox betrayed the sect long ago.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao is waiting for your response, you decide:

choices.description: Although Su Qingyao is reliable, the less she knows, the safer she is

text.content: Chen Ji revealed a simple and honest smile, gently shaking his head.

dialogue.content: 'Junior sister, this matter is complicated, with our low cultivation, we should just not get involved.'

choices.description: Su Qingyao's trust is very important, giving her some direction can make subsequent cooperation smoother
choices.visible_cost: She might get deeper into danger

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then sighed.
